task.description:
Design test cases for API-04 (Task operations) endpoints.

Read src/design/api-04-task-operations.md and the existing tests in tests/unit/test_tasks_api.zig to understand what is already covered.

Write a test spec at tests/specs/API-04.md covering:
1. GET /tasks: pagination (cursor navigation, page_size validation), filter combinations (assignee_id, status, instance_id), TASK_WORKER sees only own tasks, PROCESS_OPERATOR+ sees all.
2. GET /tasks/:id: success case, HTTP 404 for missing task.
3. POST /tasks/:id/complete: success, HTTP 409 on already-completed, HTTP 409 on already-cancelled, HTTP 403 for TASK_WORKER completing another owners task.
4. POST /tasks/:id/assign: success, HTTP 409 if already assigned, role check (PROCESS_OPERATOR+).
5. POST /tasks/:id/reassign: success, HTTP 409 if unassigned, role check (PROCESS_OPERATOR+).

For each test case provide: ID, description, preconditions, input, expected HTTP status and response body.
acceptance_criteria: All five endpoint groups have test cases
Role-based visibility tests included for GET /tasks
Each test case has ID, preconditions, input, and expected output

result.summary: Designed 37 test cases for API-04 (GET /tasks, GET /tasks/:id, POST /tasks/:id/complete, POST /tasks/:id/assign, POST /tasks/:id/reassign) across 5 endpoint groups. Covers cursor pagination, filter combinations (assignee_id, status, instance_id), role-based visibility (TASK_WORKER vs PROCESS_OPERATOR), and all error cases (403, 404, 409, 410, 422).
